title-group.article-title: Ferroelectric AlScN thin films by reactive sputtering

abstract.p: AlScN thin films were deposited by reactive magnetron sputtering.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: AlScN is a wurtzite ferroelectric material.

sec.title: Experimental
sec.p: AlScN films were deposited on Si(100) by reactive magnetron sputtering.
The AlSc target power was 200 W, Ar flow 20 sccm, N2 flow 5 sccm, and working pressure 0.5 Pa. The substrate temperature was 300 C.

caption.p: Deposition conditions for the AlScN films.

sec.title: Results and Discussion
sec.p: The films showed a c-axis oriented XRD peak and ferroelectric switching.

ref.mixed-citation: Fichtner et al., J. Appl. Phys. 125, 114103 (2019).

sec.title: Supplementary Methods
sec.p: Additional AlScN films were deposited by pulsed DC sputtering at 150 W and 0.4 Pa.
